label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the _____, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verse: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
note: Way, truth, life — three nouns, each with a definite article, no alternates offered.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto me, My _____ is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
note: Paul asked three times for the thorn's removal; God answered with sufficiency instead.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I am the _____, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verse: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
note: The vine-and-branches math: abiding yields much fruit; without him, the total is nothing.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Can two walk together, except they be _____?
verse: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
note: The first of Amos's rapid-fire questions — companionship runs on agreement, with God included.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the mystery of _____ doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verse: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
note: 'The mystery of iniquity' — lawlessness already at work, still wearing its disguise.
